title: Tanzanian Grilled Lobster
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Grilled Lobster — Indian Ocean spiny lobster halved and grilled over charcoal with a Zanzibar garlic-butter and tamarind glaze. The pinnacle of Zanzibar seafood — the most prized catch of the Indian Ocean, simply and magnificently prepared.
longDesc: Zanzibar spiny lobster grilled at the Forodhani night market for a fraction of what it would cost anywhere else in the world. The tamarind-garlic glaze is uniquely Tanzanian — the tartness of tamarind against the richness of lobster is a revelation.
steps: Make Zanzibar glaze: melt butter with garlic, tamarind, honey, turmeric, chilli. Simmer 2 minutes. Add lemon and coriander. Divide in two.
Split lobsters: sharp knife through head, push down to halve. Remove stomach sack.
Grill cut-side down over medium coals 5—6 minutes.
Flip. Brush shell side. Grill 5—6 minutes. Baste every 2 minutes.
chefTips: Do not overcook — rubbery beyond 70°C internal.
cookingScience: See KEN274 for lobster cooking science. The tamarind's tartaric acid slightly denatures surface proteins, helping the glaze adhere.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar spiny lobster from local artisanal fishermen.
culturalNote: Grilled lobster at Forodhani Gardens — the fish caught that morning, grilled that evening, eaten at the water's edge with dhows sailing past — is one of the greatest food experiences in Africa.
